juce::MemoryOutputStream Class Reference

## Detailed Description

Writes data to an internal memory buffer, which grows as required.

The data that was written into the stream can then be accessed later as a contiguous block of memory.

Creates a memory stream for writing into into a pre-existing [MemoryBlock](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MemoryBlock.html "A class to hold a resizable block of raw data.") object.

Note that the destination block will always be larger than the amount of data that has been written to the stream, because the [MemoryOutputStream](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MemoryOutputStream.html "Writes data to an internal memory buffer, which grows as required.") keeps some spare capacity at its end. To trim the block's size down to fit the actual data, call [flush()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MemoryOutputStream.html#a29766bf3587be1372979a00fbac4680a "If the stream is writing to a user-supplied MemoryBlock, this will trim any excess capacity off the b..."), or delete the [MemoryOutputStream](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MemoryOutputStream.html "Writes data to an internal memory buffer, which grows as required.").

Parameters

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| memoryBlockToWriteTo | the block into which new data will be written. |
| appendToExistingBlockContent | if this is true, the contents of the block will be kept, and new data will be appended to it. If false, the block will be cleared before use |

Creates a [MemoryOutputStream](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MemoryOutputStream.html "Writes data to an internal memory buffer, which grows as required.") that will write into a user-supplied, fixed-size block of memory.

When using this mode, the stream will write directly into this memory area until it's full, at which point write operations will fail.

juce::MemoryOutputStream Class Reference

Detailed Description

Writes data to an internal memory buffer, which grows as required.

The data that was written into the stream can then be accessed later as a contiguous block of memory.

juce::MemoryOutputStream::MemoryOutputStream ( MemoryBlock & memoryBlockToWriteTo,
bool appendToExistingBlockContent )

Creates a memory stream for writing into into a pre-existing MemoryBlock object.

Note that the destination block will always be larger than the amount of data that has been written to the stream, because the MemoryOutputStream keeps some spare capacity at its end. To trim the block's size down to fit the actual data, call flush(), or delete the MemoryOutputStream.

Parameters
memoryBlockToWriteTothe block into which new data will be written.
appendToExistingBlockContentif this is true, the contents of the block will be kept, and new data will be appended to it. If false, the block will be cleared before use
